verdict.rationale: Stagehand stores some user data, including server-side caches of act/observe/extract results and Browserbase contexts, so data portability is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents no export capability, open-format dump, or offboarding path. The local user-data directory staying on disk is adjacent persistence behavior, not an export feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
